claim: Six listener-mode tests terminate the deterministic provider with Popen.kill() but never wait for process exit or close captured stdout/stderr, leaving child and pipe resources live at object finalization.

evidence.detail: start_listener creates Popen with stdout=PIPE and stderr=PIPE and returns the live process.
Listener tests use process.kill() in finally blocks without wait(), communicate(), or explicit stream closure; the same pattern recurs at lines 171, 205, 222, 247, and 260.
The suite passes 15 tests but reproducibly emits subprocess-is-still-running and unclosed stdout/stderr ResourceWarning traces allocated by start_listener.

title: Scripted-provider listener tests do not reap child processes
